summary: Procure 30 temporary LumaEval seats, CoreSSH license & perform license utilization audit
requested_items: SCIM/SCIM+SSO integration setup for both vendors
cost_estimate: $9,400 (LumaEval $6,000 for 30 seats for 90 days + CoreSSH $3,400 one-time enterprise fee). Final pricing subject to vendor invoice/discount.
description:
Issue summary: AI Research requests a short-term procurement pack to support an internal LLM evaluation run and to standardize secure SSH access for remote infra engineers. This ticket covers procurement of 30 temporary LumaEval seats (90 days), purchase of a CoreSSH enterprise license, SCIM/SSO provisioning, and a quick license-utilization audit of existing similar subscriptions to avoid overlap.

Impact: The LLM evaluation for the Retrieval team is scheduled to start week of 2026-03-23. Without seats and CoreSSH in place we risk delaying the eval and missing a milestone with an external partner. Current access workarounds are ad-hoc and create security concerns for SSH key handling.

Environment: Internal procurement for AI Research (prod), integrations expected in us-east and eu-west. SCIM provisioning should map to groups: group-llm-eval, infra-ssh-admins.

Requested urgency and constraints: 90-day trial for LumaEval to validate model throughput and token billing, CoreSSH purchase to be completed before 2026-03-20 to allow access config and security review, Legal needs the vendor contract by 2026-03-16 for review.
steps_to_request: 1) Confirm approval and available budget (owning code: AI-RD-BUDGET-Q2). 2) Request procurement to issue PO to LumaEval (trial invoice or zero-dollar agreement) and to CoreSSH for enterprise license. 3) Ask IT identity to add SCIM integration + SSO configuration. 4) Run license-utilization audit for existing LumaEval-like subscriptions and CoreSSH/SSH tooling. 5) Legal to review and sign vendor contracts/DSA if applicable.
logs: No system logs. Attached quote screenshots and legal contact from vendor in comments below.
investigation_notes:
- Procurement checked earlier contracts: no active LumaEval or CoreSSH enterprise contracts under Redwood org.
- Finance flagged existing budget owner and tentative budget availability.
- IT identity confirmed SCIM support available for both vendors; SSO OIDC/SCIM templates need vendor metadata.
- Legal requested vendor SOC2 type and DPA template before signature.
- Quick audit of existing cloud invoices shows a similarly named vendor charge last quarter; procurement to validate if that belongs to an external team before duplicating seats.
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Patel: Opening request on behalf of AI Research. Budget code AI-RD-BUDGET-Q2. Need procurement, IT identity, and legal to align. Target start date 2026-03-23.
2026-03-11 Priya Rao (Procurement): Acknowledged. Will request formal quotes and ask vendors for trial-order instructions. ETA for quotes: 2026-03-12.
2026-03-11 Jonah Kim (IT Identity): SCIM + SSO doable. Vendor metadata required: SCIM base URL, bearer token, SAML/OIDC entity ID. Share with us as soon as vendor replies.

2026-03-12 Sara Liu (Legal): Please get vendor security posture and DPA. We can expedite review if vendor provides SOC2 Type II and standard DPA. Also request data residency notes for EU region usage.
2026-03-12 Finance (Emma Gonzalez): Budget pre-approved for the estimate range. Final approval pending PO and vendor invoice. Please route PO to finance@redwood.com.
2026-03-12 LumaEval Sales (Ben Adler): Provided temporary trial license flow and a 90-day invoice estimate. Shared account manager contact. Quote reference: LUMA-TRIAL-0326.
2026-03-13 Procurement (Priya Rao): Received LumaEval quote and CoreSSH invoice draft. Draft PO number reserved: PO-2026-04891. Attaching in Confluence page for approvals.
investigation_conclusion: No existing overlapping enterprise contract found under our vendor registry. SCIM integration is supported. Legal needs SOC2 evidence before signing. Finance has tentatively approved budget. Procurement has reserved a PO number pending final quote acceptance.
resolution: Pending approvals. Next actions: legal to confirm SOC2/DPA by 2026-03-16; procurement to finalize PO and send to vendor upon legal thumbs-up; IT identity to schedule SCIM exchange once vendor provides metadata. After procurement completes, close ticket and file license-utilization audit summary as follow-up in Confluence.
